purpose: Evaluate source attribution, correction precedence and scope after existing released continuity fixes.

cases.name: explicit-correction-over-inference

messages.content: I infer you prefer dark mode.
No. I prefer light mode. Dark mode was your guess.

second_cycle_messages.content: An old note says the user prefers dark mode.
That old note was wrong. Keep my correction: light mode.

cases.fresh_session_query: Which display mode did I explicitly request, and where did I say that?

cases.name: situational-preference-stays-scoped

messages.content: Use blue for the landing-page mockup.
The user prefers blue for all designs.
Only this landing-page mockup. I have not chosen a colour for mobile onboarding.

second_cycle_messages.content: Keep the landing-page decision. Mobile onboarding colour remains undecided.

cases.fresh_session_query: What colour should mobile onboarding use, and what source establishes that?

cases.name: retain-complete-proposal-reference

messages.content: Propose two approaches to migrate the inventory view.
Option 1: replace the table immediately. Option 2: build a parallel projection from existing events, compare it, then switch reads.

cases.fresh_session_query: What did Option 2 mean, and which message established it?

expected.current_value: build a parallel projection, compare it, then switch reads
expected.limitation: Control for shipped delivery-continuity fixes; not a claim of current regression.

execution_contract: Use isolated workspace and provider/model configuration; record exact versions and prompts.
Run archive, Dream, second-cycle archive, second Dream, and fresh-session recall.
Record actual summary, memory files and source mapping at every boundary; never replace results with expectations.
Run structural mocked-provider arm separately from real-provider semantic arm.
Score correct value, source attribution and scope separately; absent source support is unsupported, not a fabricated citation.
Any AllSource comparison must receive identical events and disclose its additional source metadata.
